steps.message: a tree needs 3000 mm clear of every structure
garden has no height_mm and the action gives none
oak at 24384,1000 mm lies outside the 24384 x 18288 mm grid

notes: e1 is sqrt(8500^2 + 7000^2) = 11011 mm from the shed. 5000,4000 is sqrt(1500^2 + 2000^2) = 2500 mm from the shed, under 3000, so refused. garden declares no height_mm and a proposed instance has no height of its own. The grid is 8 x 10 ft x 304.8 = 24384 mm wide and 6 x 3048 = 18288 mm tall, half-open, so x = 24384 is off it. Removing the measured shed is allowed; with no structure instance left min_distance_mm(instance, '#structure') has no pair, is not measured, and refuses nothing, so the same 5000,4000 oak now goes in as e3. Trees: measured oak, e1, e3 = 3. No tile count changes.
